title: JujuContext creation fails when loading JUJU_MACHINE_ID
body:
From [Matrix](https://matrix.to/#/!xdClnUGkurzjxqiQcN:ubuntu.com/$Bss03fOsKh7m42_eJZWvaGL5SWK3h2Kve02BGQdg3Zw?via=ubuntu.com&via=matrix.org&via=sft.lol):

I have an issue with one charm that I've already written, avaialble here https://github.com/dell-esg/powermax-cinder-charm
When deploying it, the following error shows up in the logs

```
'unit-cinder-powermax1646-2: 16:10:03 WARNING unit.cinder-powermax1646/2.install   File "/var/lib/juju/agents/unit-cinder-powermax1646-2/charm/venv/ops/jujucontext.py", line 256, in _from_dict
unit-cinder-powermax1646-2: 16:10:03 WARNING unit.cinder-powermax1646/2.install     machine_id=int(env['JUJU_MACHINE_ID']) if env.get('JUJU_MACHINE_ID') else None,
unit-cinder-powermax1646-2: 16:10:03 WARNING unit.cinder-powermax1646/2.install ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '0/lxd/4'
```
author: tonyandrewmeyer

comments.body: We added exposure of the machine ID in the recent JujuContext changes in #1996.

Locally, my environment looks like:

```
JUJU_MACHINE_ID=90
```

However, [it does seem like it's a string in Juju](https://github.com/juju/names/blob/b50ca77a4137d8a23ec895d76d051d88248ecdee/machine.go#L31), so it must vary depending on the kind of machine.
